title: Act: Add interaction helper module
description: Add pure functions pointInBounds, availableActions, isActivationKey and nextFocusIndex reusing evaluateAll.
acceptance_criteria: Module exports the four functions with typed signatures
availableActions uses evaluateAll on each action's conditions

steps.action: Create the file; export pointInBounds(spec: ObjectSpec, px: number, py: number): boolean returning false when spec.interactionBounds is undefined, else true when px and py lie within [position.x + b.x*scale, +b.width*scale] and [position.y + b.y*scale, +b.height*scale] inclusive of the left/top edge and exclusive of the right/bottom edge
steps.code: const b = spec.interactionBounds; if (!b) return false; const x0 = spec.position.x + b.x * spec.scale; const y0 = spec.position.y + b.y * spec.scale; return px >= x0 && px < x0 + b.width * spec.scale && py >= y0 && py < y0 + b.height * spec.scale;
steps.expected: Function compiles and returns booleans per the bounds rule

steps.action: Export availableActions(state: GameState, spec: ObjectSpec): ActionSpec[] returning spec.actions.filter(a => evaluateAll(state, a.conditions)); import evaluateAll from './conditions'
steps.expected: Only actions with passing conditions are returned

steps.action: Export isActivationKey(key: string): boolean returning true for 'Enter' and ' ' only
steps.expected: Returns true only for Enter and Space

steps.action: Export nextFocusIndex(count: number, current: number, delta: 1 | -1): number returning -1 when count <= 0, else ((current + delta) % count + count) % count
steps.code: if (count <= 0) return -1; return (((current + delta) % count) + count) % count;
steps.expected: Focus index wraps in both directions
